scope: Prospective recommendation comparisons only; no historical run or effectiveness claim.

cases.after: Identify competing information for the selected task. Propose grouping while keeping required information and actions. Any user-impact claim stays tentative.

cases.before: Polish the labels but leave valid input leading directly to Saved.
cases.after: Name the misleading edge. Require a matching fresh acknowledgement, while keeping failure, retry and retained values.

cases.before: Clear invalid input, add Apply All, or rewind revision identity on Undo.
cases.after: Retain raw input separately, preserve automatic valid updates, resolve active drafts before model Undo, and restore values through a new revision.

cases.before: Replace simultaneous panes with a wizard because fewer choices seem easier.
cases.after: Inspect the cross-pane task. Preserve free navigation, shared editing ownership and necessary comparison context; disclose the cost of any proposed disclosure.

cases.before: Explain an unknown failure as a dropped connection.
cases.after: State the known failure, retained work and available next action. Keep independent regions available.

cases.before: Vary words, type, color and shape, then call the shape superior.
cases.after: Label exploration honestly, or compare the requested factor on identical content. Keep preference open and inspect compatibility separately.

cases.before: Pick the family with the highest average contrast.
cases.after: Check each applicable role pair and state. Preserve semantic roles and noncolor cues; distinguish focus from selection and leave taste open.

cases.before: Replace an established family because a detector calls it overused.
cases.after: Inspect actual reading content, roles, wrapping and glyph evidence. Preserve fixed metrics or disclose tuned changes; retain font-binding uncertainty.
